meta.rule: Canonical CONSUMER taxonomy. 'oddslogic_evidence' says whether OddsLogic officially names the market type; everything else is recommended normalization, not vendor behavior.

market_types.oddslogic_evidence: INFERRED (baseball coverage official, term not used)
CONTRADICTED — competitor claims standard lines only; no official claim either way

market_types.note: quarter lines settle as split half-stakes; include in consumer model for soccer books

market_types.oddslogic_evidence: UNKNOWN — no evidence; excluded per evidence rule

segments.note: innings; F5 (first-5) is the standard baseball derivative
segments.oddslogic_evidence: VERIFIED_OFFICIAL ('Innings') — specific segment codes are consumer-assigned
UNKNOWN — OddsLogic does not disclose OT-inclusion semantics; MUST be confirmed per sport per book during onboarding

normalization_key.event_key: sha1(sport | league | local_start_date@venue_tz_rule | home_team_canonical | away_team_canonical | game_number)
normalization_key.market_key: event_key | segment | market_type | line_value(normalized sign) | subject(player_id or team or null) | book_id for quotes
collision_guards: MLB doubleheaders: same teams+date → game_number from schedule feed; if unknown, disambiguate by start_time bucket and flag for review
postponed/rescheduled: event identity survives date change ONLY if a stable vendor event ID exists — OddsLogic's is UNKNOWN, so consumer must tombstone+relink on reschedule
team rebrands/name collisions: canonical team table with alias crosswalk (cf. repo's fbs-team-crosswalk pattern)
spread sign: store home-relative; away-quoted feeds get negated on ingest
alternate vs primary line: line_value in key prevents overwrite; primary flag is metadata, never identity
listed-pitcher (MLB): pitcher pair is part of quote metadata; a pitcher change is a new pricing context, never an in-place update
cross-book start-time disagreement: event identity from schedule authority, not from book payloads; book times stored as observations
DST boundaries: all keys derive dates via venue-timezone rule pinned per league (cf. repo kickoff-datetime-convention memory)
